answer: Each ballot pays its own freight. Each identity files one sonnet per ballot, burning 9 POA into the ocean pot. Per epoch the roll releases a fresh falcon — a nonce the key signs back within 40 seconds — and the sonnet carries its band. Lottery rangers replay one sonnet in ten per epoch, re-flying its falcon. A missed, stale, or shared band voids the sonnet: vote struck, the burned 9 POA stays in the ocean, key benched two epochs. N fakes × 9 POA = 9N POA burned per ballot. Honest keys burn the same 9.
